# causal-conv1d 1.1.2 observed Python interface

Copied byte-for-byte from the verified installed-runtime archive. License,
authors and distribution metadata are retained in the adjacent dist-info
folder. No CUDA binary is in Git. These files are provenance; selecting this
interface still requires the matching installed causal_conv1d_cuda extension.
Use the environment guide and verify CUDA forward/backward before replay.
